info.description: REST API behind the Naridon app and AI Marketer. Authenticate with a per-shop API key (`X-API-Key`) or a signed-in session token (`Authorization: Bearer`). Paths are relative to https://app.naridon.com.

post.summary: Send a message to AI Marketer
post.description:
Streams the reply as Server-Sent Events (`text/event-stream`). Events: `text_delta`, `tool_call_start`, `tool_call_result`, `tool_call_blocked`, `confirmation_required`, `artifact`, `tour_action`, `error`, `done`.

Body: `message` (up to 4,000 characters; may be empty when `attachments` are sent), `attachments` (ids from `POST /api/v1/chat/attachments`, up to 6), `history` (up to 60 prior `{ role, content }` turns), optional `conversationId`, `model` (`auto` | `gemini`), `effort` (`low` | `medium` | `high`; defaults to `medium`).

Actions that change, publish, spend or delete stop with `confirmation_required`; answer it with `POST /api/v1/chat/confirm`. API keys can use read-only capabilities only.
Uploads one file for the next message. Images (PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC/HEIF), PDF and text files (txt, md, csv, tsv, json, html, xml, yaml, log). Up to 10 MB per file and 30 MB per message.

post.summary: Approve or reject a pending action
post.description: Answers a `confirmation_required` event: `{ confirmationId, approved }`. The server runs only the action it stored under that id, once, and streams the continuation as Server-Sent Events. Pending actions expire after 15 minutes.

post.description: Returns one of three response shapes discriminated by `mfaRequired` / `mfaEnrollmentRequired`: a full session when no 2FA is needed, a challenge token when the user has 2FA enabled, or an enrollment token when the user is unenrolled but at least one of their orgs requires 2FA.

delete.description: Requires proof of possession — a valid TOTP code or an unused recovery code — before deleting the UserTwoFactor row and every recovery code so a re-enroll starts clean.

post.summary: Send an email OTP for an active MFA challenge
post.description: Requires an unexpired mfaChallengeToken issued by /login. Returns the OTP's remaining lifetime AND the resend cooldown so the client can render an independent countdown; refuses (429 EMAIL_OTP_THROTTLED) when a send has occurred inside the cooldown.

post.summary: Confirm TOTP enrollment; issue recovery codes
post.description: Verifies the initial TOTP code, enables 2FA, and returns 8 one-time recovery codes (shown once). When called with an enrollment token, the response also carries a full session so the frontend can transition straight into the app.

delete.summary: Disable email OTP as a second factor
delete.description: Requires proof of possession: a TOTP code (if TOTP is enrolled), the currently active email OTP, or an unused recovery code. Leaves TOTP untouched. Refused (403 MFA_REQUIRED_BY_ORG) if the resulting state would have no factor and an org policy mandates 2FA.

post.summary: Enable email OTP as a second factor
post.description: Idempotent. Coexists with TOTP; either, both, or neither may be enabled. Email address is already proof-of-ownership from signup, so no confirmation code is required at enable time.

post.summary: Send an email OTP to the signed-in user's inbox
post.description: Session-authed. Used from settings to obtain a proof code for disabling email OTP when it is the user's only factor. Returns the OTP's remaining lifetime and the resend cooldown.

get.summary: Whether the caller must enroll 2FA (per org policy)
get.description: Returns `required: true` when any org the caller belongs to has `mfaRequired = true`, along with the enforcing org(s) so the settings UI can name them. Uses the same fan-out the login flow uses to decide the enrollment-required branch, exposed here so an already-signed-in user can see the requirement before their next login.

post.summary: Start TOTP enrollment (returns secret + otpauth URI)
post.description: Accepts either a session bearer (user reconfiguring 2FA) or a short-lived enrollment token issued when a policy-gated login forced enrollment. The returned secret is shown once — the user scans the URI as a QR code and confirms with /mfa/confirm.
Requires a fresh TOTP proof so a hijacked session cannot silently rotate a user's recovery codes. Returns the new codes exactly once — the previous batch is invalidated atomically.

post.summary: Redeem an MFA challenge and receive a session
post.description: Accepts either a 6-digit TOTP code or a XXXXX-XXXXX recovery code. Rate-limited to 5 failures per 15 minutes per user. Returns the same session shape as /login for the not-required branch.

get.description: Returns whether the organization currently requires all members to enroll 2FA. Missing policy row = OPTIONAL (false).

put.description: Sets whether the organization requires all members to enroll 2FA. Turning it on will force any not-yet-enrolled member into the enrollment flow at their next login.
